LESSON: LEVERS AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.2: Levers as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Levers as simple machines. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are levers used in day to day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
3. classify levers into the three classes
4. demonstrate the use of levers in making work easier
5. appreciate the use of levers in making work easier

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LEVERS AS SIMPLE MACHINES
This lesson teaches Levers as simple machines for Grade 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. classify levers into the three classes
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. demonstrate the use of levers in making work easier
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. appreciate the use of levers in making work easier
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Levers as simple machines using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Levers as simple machines above.
2. Explain Levers as simple machines to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Levers as simple machines.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Levers as simple machines with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Levers as simple machines important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are levers used in day to day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify common levers used in day- to-day life
2. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier
3. classify levers into the three classes
4. demonstrate the use of levers in making work easier

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
